answer_1.quote: we introduce Lotus (Large Language Models On Translation of Unseen and Underrepresented Scripts), a benchmark designed to explore whether LLMs can translate languages written in underrepresented scripts that they have not seen before.

answer_2.quote: Our main evaluation metric is chrF++, which is more appropriate for low-resource languages. We also report SacreBLEU scores for completeness.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation, and the results are presented in Table . Four participants who had never studied Mongolian or Yi were recruited as non-native evaluators, and two native Mongolian speakers participated as native evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Provided all linguistic resources except the test set, along with a brief grammar guide of no more than 500 words; allowed use of search engines but prohibited translation software or LLMs.
